Title: Weather Page
Summary: Weather forecast page that displays simulated weather data via IWeatherService.
Content:
## Weather.razor **Path:** `Components/Pages/Weather.razor` **Type:** Routable page component ### Route ```razor @page "/weather" ``` ### Dependencies | Service | Type | Purpose | |---------|------|---------| | `WeatherService` | `IWeatherService` | Retrieves simulated weather forecast data. | ### Injection ```razor @inject MyBlazorApp.Contracts.IWeatherService WeatherService ``` ### Content ```razor Weather

Weather

This component demonstrates showing data.

@if (forecasts == null) {

Loading...

} else { @foreach (var forecast in forecasts) { }
Date Temp. (C) Temp. (F) Summary
@forecast.Date.ToShortDateString() @forecast.TemperatureC @forecast.TemperatureF @forecast.Summary
} ``` ### State | Member | Type | Description | |--------|------|-------------| | `forecasts` | `WeatherForecast[]?` | The loaded forecast data. `null` while loading. | ### Lifecycle #### OnInitializedAsync ```csharp protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() { forecasts = await WeatherService.GetForecastsAsync(); } ``` Calls `IWeatherService.GetForecastsAsync()` with default parameters (5 days, 500ms delay). ### Accessibility - `aria-label` attributes on temperature headers describe the unit for screen readers. - Loading state shows `Loading...` for clear feedback. ### Notes - Previously contained inline business logic and a private `WeatherForecast` class. **Refactored** to use `IWeatherService` and the shared `WeatherForecast` model. - The 500ms delay is intentional to demonstrate loading UI. - Data is randomly generated on each page visit.
